title: Power Electronics Lead / Architect
requiredSkills: Realization of complex system requirements to provide robust and reliable hardware solutions.
Collaboration with other team members (including both hardware, firmware, software and mechanical engineers) to agree system designs, interces and protocols etc.
Strong in embedded hardware product design, Debug, and Test
Familiar with the standard principles, concepts, and application of embedded hardware engineering.
Component selection, Schematics design, Preparing BOM and PCB Design guidelines and constraints
EAGLE/ALTIUM/Orcad/Mentor/Cadence Schematic and PCB design software experience preferred.
Design Simulations using PSpice/LT Spice/TINA
Interfacing sensors on the embedded system
Interfacing Protocols like Bluetooth/BLE, WiFi, USB, I2C, UART, SPI, Ethernet, CAN/LIN/FLexray
Handling of Digital Oscilloscopes, Multi-meter, Power Analyzer, Logic Analyzer (software and hardware).
Power budgeting, design of efficient power regulation electronics (LDOs and DC-DC converters)
Work with designs involving ARM microprocessors/ microcontrollers, FPGAs, standard digital logic ICs
Memory Interface - SRAM, DDR, Flash, Memory Cards.
Work on Analog and mixed signal designs including Opamps, ADCs, DACs, switches, etc.
Power Semiconductors:
Power Diodes, Power MOSFETS, SCR/Triac, SiC, IGBT, GaN, Power Transistors, Gate Drivers, Isolation Techniques, Snubbers, Filters.
High Power and Low Power AC-DC Converters, DC-DC Converters, PFC, Inverters, Thermal Management
AC/DC Motor Control - LV, HV, BLDC, Brushed DC, Stepper Motors,
BMS, On Board Battery Chargers and Standalone Chargers,
Basic Embedded software using C / C++.
Individual board bring up and module wise testing and debug
Integration of the different modules to a final product
Knowledge on soldering through hole and SMD components.
Exposure to ISO9001 processes and documentation.
ISO26262 - Functional Safety awareness
EMI / EMC Compliance and other Regulatory Compliance
Reliability Analysis, MTBF, RCA, FBD
Working knowledge of Signal / Power / Thermal Integrity.
FPGA programming skills - desirable
Ability to provide practical solutions and work effectively in a team environment
Should be passionate, diligent, thorough, and detail oriented.
Excellent problem solving, analytical, and communication skills.
Should be a Self-Learner, Team Leader, possess good communication & interpersonal skills.
